verdict.rationale: A scraping and web-reading API could plausibly host a developer marketplace, so this axis applies. The evidence covers Reader's URL-to-markdown conversion, search, output headers, self-hosting and proxy features. Nothing in the pack shows a way to publish custom scrapers to a public marketplace or earn revenue from them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it
